ValidationRule.description: Requires Close Date Validated, Executed Agreement Uploaded, Final Pricing & Terms Proposed, and Value Hypothesis & Scope Reviewed to be populated leaving Stage 3, and to remain populated through every later stage and once Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Framework_Parent_Opportunity" ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "New Deal"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Cross-Sell/Upsell") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "High Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Medium Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "Low Touch"), ISPICKVAL(Touch_Level__c, "No Touch") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "RIM"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "Digital"), ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "ALM") ),
OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booking Verification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booked") ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Booked"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Setup") ), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed") ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Close_Date_Validated__c,""), ISPICKVAL(Executed_Agreement_Uploaded__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(Final_Pricing_Terms_Proposed__c,""), NOT(Value_Hypothesis_Scope_Reviewed__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete Close Date Validated, Executed Agreement Uploaded, Final Pricing & Terms Proposed, and Value Hypothesis & Scope Reviewed before leaving Stage 3. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
